cohort: 600 females (120 cases and 480 controls) who utilized obstetrics and gynecology services at Jimma University Specialized Hospital from January 2010 to December 2014
finding: Maternal mortality ratio showed a decreasing trend from 1,873/100,000 in 2010 to 350/100,000 in 2014, with hemorrhage being the leading cause of death (54%).
